description: Independent raw-prediction, weighted-pair bootstrap and raw-timing verification for both retained sessions; no new training or test-driven tuning.

reproduced_v1.description: Prediction metrics, seed aggregation, paired intervals and saved timing summaries checked against underlying evidence.

retrained_v1.description: Prediction metrics, seed aggregation, paired intervals and saved timing summaries checked against underlying evidence.

bootstrap.description: Independent weighted positive-negative pair counting with half-credit for ties reproduces the original rank-sum resampling results within 1e-14.

throughput_limitation: Inference wall-throughput rates are recorded measurements. Original wall-duration denominators were not retained separately, so CUDA-event samples cannot independently reconstruct those denominators; case-selection/aggregation was checked against recorded rates. Synthetic step throughput is fully recomputed from saved synchronized wall step times.
acceptance_scope: Technical statistical/artifact review; not supervisor or clinical approval.
